props.markdown:
So clocks slow down in two steps. A small gear of 8 teeth is fixed on the gear of 30 and turns with it. It drives one last gear.

The two slowdowns multiply: three times, then again.
Size the last gear until the train turns twelve times slower.

props.title: The gear train, whose last gear you can size
props.textAlternative: **Text version.** Seen from slightly above: the coral gear of 10 teeth drives the yellow gear of 30, three times slower. On the same axle, a yellow gear of 8 teeth drives a green gear. A slider sets the green gear's teeth from 16 to 48, and a label says how much slower it turns than the minute shaft. With 32 teeth, four times slower than the gear of 8, the whole train turns twelve times slower.
